evidence: Labeled 'Tests'; refactors unit test cases in src/test/transaction_tests.cpp and src/test/script_tests.cpp to eliminate shared mutable state.
rationale: Refactoring unit test cases to eliminate shared mutable state improves test independence, but is internal test cleanup with no claim on scarce review time. The PR splits script_combineSigs into fixture-based tests and introduces a helper lambda in spends_witness_prog so checks no longer rely on 'state left by preceding checks' (tracking issue #36692). Test code cleanliness ranks lowest among test infrastructure concerns.
